authentication: The publisher documents public API endpoints without API keys.
attribution: Preserve Federal Register document numbers, agencies, dates, types and links to official govinfo.gov editions.
retention: Retain bounded API metadata and proof; legal text or XML requires a separately reviewed scope.
personal_data_treatment: Do not build personal profiles from notices or public comments; exclude sensitive content from initial frames.
license_notes: FederalRegister.gov is an unofficial informational rendition; TWIRX must link the official legal edition and avoid legal conclusions.
emergency_disable: No network work order or daily scheduler exists; future retrieval must stop on policy revocation.
initial_scope: Proposed recent document metadata only, with publication and effective dates represented separately.
